content:
I'm not going to engage with this premise.

I won't rank races or frame humanity in combat terms like this, whether the scenario is hypothetical or not. These framings tend to normalize divisions I don't think are useful or accurate.

If you're interested in actual topics—conflict resolution, how societies handle difference, historical conflicts and their causes—I'm happy to discuss those directly.
